description: This file defines the IntellijRegistrationDetector class, which extends RegistrationDetector to perform Android class registration checks using PSI structure within an IntelliJ environment. It includes methods for creating visitors, checking classes, and reporting issues related to manifest registration.

classes.name: IntellijRegistrationDetector
classes.description: A detector class that uses PSI to verify Android component registration in the manifest, tailored for IntelliJ IDEA.

methods.name: getApplicableNodeTypes
methods.description: Returns the node types (CompilationUnit) this detector applies to.

methods.name: createJavaVisitor
methods.description: Creates an AST visitor that triggers the check method on compilation units.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs PSI-based checks on Java files to verify registration of Android components.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Recursively checks a PsiClass and its inner classes for proper registration, reporting issues if not registered.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Reports an unregistered class issue to the context, with details about the class and its registration status.
